data.title: Mercedes-Benz USA Reports Quarterly Passenger Car Sales Growth of 4%
data.description:
Mercedes-Benz USA Reports Quarterly Passenger Car Sales Growth of 4%

  • Mercedes-Benz USA retailed 76,200 passenger cars in Q3 2026, representing a 4% increase over Q3 2025.
  • Third-quarter retail sales totaled 85,800 units (+3%), comprised of 76,200 passenger cars and 9,600 vans.
  • The Core segment delivered double-digit quarterly growth (+12%) and year-to-date gains (+5%), underpinned by outstanding demand for Mercedes-Benz SUVs.
  • Top-End vehicle sales remained strong, led by 47% S-Class growth and high demand across the Mercedes-Maybach model range.

Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA) today reported third-quarter passenger car sales of 76,200 vehicles, which represents a 4% increase for passenger car sales over Q3 2025. With 9,600 vans delivered throughout Q3, overall MBUSA retail sales for the quarter were up 3% with 85,800 units sold.

The quarterly growth and strong momentum was fueled by sustained demand across the Mercedes-Benz SUV lineup, the Core vehicle portfolio, and the Top-End vehicle range. The Alabama-built GLE delivered double-digit year-to-date growth, while the GLC remained one of the brand's highest-volume models with positive year-to-date gains. The E-Class and S-Class also delivered exceptional quarterly gains of 39% and 47%, respectively.

“Together with our fantastic dealer partners, we delivered positive growth and outperformed a challenging automotive market. Our gains reflect the strong appeal of our broad and versatile family of SUVs, the continued strength of our top-end vehicle range and the enduring power of the Mercedes-Benz brand. With a robust pipeline of new, highly compelling products arriving at U.S. dealerships including the new GLE and GLS SUVs and the new S-Class, we will further strengthen our U.S. vehicle portfolio to build on this momentum.”

Adam Chamberlain, President and CEO of Mercedes-Benz USA

Top-End:
Demand for the Mercedes-Benz Top-End vehicle portfolio remained strong in the third quarter, led by continued momentum from the S-Class which reported 47% growth in Q3. Mercedes-Maybach sales increased 21% year-to-date, highlighting continued customer desire for the brand's most exclusive models. The successful launch of the highly anticipated new S-Class Sedan marks the next chapter in its long history, reinforcing its position as the flagship luxury sedan setting the benchmark in the industry.

Core:
The Core segment remained strong, delivering growth both in the quarter (+12%) and year-to-date (+5%). The GLC and GLE remained key pillars of the Mercedes-Benz portfolio in the third quarter. The GLE, proudly built in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, delivered double-digit year-to-date growth, underscoring the unwavering customer demand for premium SUVs in the U.S. market.

Entry:
Entry vehicle retail sales were up 3% in the third quarter, with the GLA posting notable sales gains of 63% for Q3.

Vans:
Demand for premium commercial mobility solutions remained resilient, driving Mercedes-Benz Vans retail sales up 1% to 9,600 units in the third quarter. Supported by a comprehensive lineup that combines versatility, capability, and innovation, the Vans business continues to provide customers with tailored transportation solutions to meet a diverse range of operational and industry needs.

Mercedes-Benz Group:
Globally, Mercedes-Benz continued to gain momentum from its product offensive in the third quarter, driven by growing customer demand for new combustion-engine and battery-electric vehicles. Mercedes-Benz Group sold 491,700 cars and vans, while group-wide battery-electric vehicle (BEV) sales across Cars and Vans increased by 52%.

“Mercedes-Benz Cars achieved the highest quarterly BEV sales in the company’s history, led by the electric GLC, whose sales more than tripled compared with Q2. Outside China, car sales increased for the third consecutive quarter in 2026. Our new electric models GLC, CLA, GLB and GLA are sold out in Europe for the rest of the year, with order books extending into 2027. This demonstrates that our product launch program is in full swing.”

Mathias Geisen, Member of the Board of Management of Mercedes-Benz Group AG, Sales & Customer Experience

Mercedes-Benz Anniversary Year “140 Years of Innovation”
Since Carl Benz filed the patent for the first automobile 140 years ago and Gottlieb Daimler built his motorized carriage shortly afterwards, Mercedes‑Benz has dedicated itself to constant innovation and to creating the world’s most desirable cars for customers. This ambition has driven every innovation – from the world's first automobile in 1886 to the biggest product launch program in the company’s history that is currently underway. With its passion for performance and pioneering power, excellence and an unwavering commitment to customer service, the brand has consistently shaped the future of mobility. The result goes well beyond engineering achievement – it creates the unmistakable feeling that leads through everything Mercedes‑Benz does: Welcome home.

Mercedes-Benz is celebrating 140 years of innovation by driving three new S-Class sedans on a trans-continental journey to 140 locations worldwide. Each place highlights the brand’s technology, heritage, pioneering spirit and worldwide presence. Along the way customers, fans and colleagues will get to join in the celebrations - on an epic adventure that will run until October. Follow the “140 Years. 140 Places” drive across six continents on our “140 Years of Innovation | Mercedes-Benz Media” special and via the Mercedes-Benz Community.

About Mercedes-Benz USA
Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA), headquartered in Atlanta, is responsible for the distribution, marketing, and customer service for all Mercedes-Benz products in the United States. MBUSA offers drivers the most diverse lineup in the luxury segment with 18 model lines ranging from the sporty GLA SUV to the flagship S-Class and the dynamic all-electric vehicles from Mercedes-Benz. MBUSA is also responsible for Mercedes-Benz Vans in the U.S. More information on MBUSA and its products can be found at www.mbusa.com and www.mbvans.com. To learn more about all Mercedes-Benz entities in North America, visit https://group.mercedes-benz.com/northamerica/.

Accredited journalists can visit our media site at media.mbusa.com.

data.title: Agibank Named Official Lead Sponsor for Legendary Brazilian Club Santos FC
data.description:
Agibank Named Official Lead Sponsor for Legendary Brazilian Club Santos FC

The company will debut on jerseys this Sunday against Fluminense at the historic Maracanã Stadium

Agibank today was announced as the official lead sponsor for Brazilian soccer club Santos Futebol Clube. The agreement is valid through the end of the 2026 season, and the Agibank brand will occupy the primary space on the front of the men's team jerseys. The sponsorship is set to debut this Sunday, October 18, in the match against Fluminense at the Maracanã. Agibank is a subsidiary of Agi Inc. (NYSE: AGBK) (“Agi”).

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261016236386/en/

As the official lead sponsor for Brazilian soccer club Santos Futebol Clube, Agibank appears in the primary space on the team jerseys.

The partnership aligns with Agibank’s positioning as a bank that welcomes and empowers all Brazilians with the tradition of a club that is deeply rooted in the history and collective memory of Brazilian football. With a loyal and enthusiastic fanbase that dates back to 1912, Santos offers Agibank the opportunity to connect with diverse audiences through a passion shared by millions of Brazilians.

"The arrival of Agibank as a sponsor, occupying one of the main properties on our sacred jersey, is yet another demonstration of the strength of the Santos FC brand and the credibility of our management. A partnership like this is important for maintaining a great team and executing projects currently under development. The search for new revenue is a permanent focus. Santos FC and Agibank will play together," highlights Marcelo Teixeira, president of Santos FC.

"Santos brings together a tradition that spans generations, a strong connection with the Brazilian public, and a far-reaching digital presence. It was the Brazilian football club with the highest growth and engagement on social media in 2025 and 2026, and features stars in its squad such as Neymar, Coutinho, and Gabigol. This combination makes the partnership a strategic asset for Agibank, with the potential to increase our brand awareness and strengthen our proximity to millions of Brazilians," says Matheus Girardi, CMO of Agibank.

About Agi

Agi stands for a banking experience that welcomes and empowers all Brazilians through a business model that is unique in Brazil. Designed to serve a customer base that represents the majority of the Brazilian population, our model addresses needs that remain outside the priorities of traditional large banks and purely digital banks. We fill a gap in the market by serving, with quality and dignity, customers who are often overlooked.

Our hybrid model combines the best of both worlds: a fully digital bank that is light, fast, and easy to use, complemented by physical branches that offer a welcoming, agile, and accessible in-person experience for all Brazilians. We develop tailored solutions and provide a simple, inclusive customer journey for non-digital-native clients, creating a meaningful competitive advantage. This approach enables us to attract more customers, build long-lasting relationships, and strengthen our growth trajectory.

About Santos

Founded in 1912 in Santos, São Paulo, Brazil, Santos Futebol Clube is one of the most historic and renowned football clubs in the world. Internationally recognized for developing legendary players such as Pelé and Neymar Jr., the club has built a rich legacy of success. Known for its attacking style of play and strong tradition of developing young talent, Santos FC remains a global reference in football and a symbol of Brazilian sporting excellence.

data.title: Could an Anthropic IPO put your 401(k) at risk? The AI safety debate hits a new dimension.
data.description:
By Christine Ji

Anthropic and NYC Comptroller Mark Levine have opened a line of communication to discuss 'existential risks' posed by AI and what that could mean for the company's future stock

Investors have reportedly discussed a lower $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic, down from an earlier $2 trillion target.

As Anthropic prepares to go public, Wall Street is grappling with the unprecedented question of how to price the risks associated with artificial-intelligence calamity.

In the company's IPO prospectus, Anthropic reportedly warned that the technology could pose "existential risks to humanity," according to a Wednesday report from the Financial Times. The story noted that the company flagged the potential for AI to display unpredictable and malicious behaviors as "risk factors." Anthropic has yet to make its filing public.

On Wednesday, New York City Comptroller Mark Levine sent a letter to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging the company to pause its IPO proceedings until it fully addresses safety and governance issues surrounding AI technology. Anthropic and Levine are holding open discussions.

"If they go public and then there is a catastrophic safety incident beyond, far beyond, what we've seen right now, that would be terrible for their stock," Levine said in an interview with Bloomberg on Friday.

Anthropic's initial public offering is projected to be one of the biggest ever - potentially surpassing SpaceX's (SPCX) $1.77 trillion public debut. An IPO of that scale would likely have a large impact on major stock indexes, Levine noted. As comptroller, he oversees New York City's pension funds, which hold over $325 billion in assets, and he's concerned that passive index-tracking funds will automatically absorb exposure to Anthropic and AI risk.

The city has around $120 billion in passive investments, Levine said. Once Anthropic goes public, it will be subject to increased financial scrutiny and new pressures that may distract it from AI safety, Levine added.

Anthropic did not immediately respond to a MarketWatch request for comment.

Safety concerns aside, investors appear to be dialing back their expectations for Anthropic's IPO as new details about the company's financials have emerged. During its investor day, Anthropic shared that it generated $16.8 billion in the quarter that ended Sept. 30. While that was up 50% from the previous quarter, revenue growth decelerated from the 140% jump between the first and second quarter of 2026, according to Wednesday's Financial Times story.

According to a Thursday Reuters report, some investors are now discussing a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic, down from a $2 trillion target valuation previously.

-Christine Ji

data.title: Golden State Dermatology Opens New Morgan Hill Clinic, Bringing Dedicated Board-Certified Dermatology Care to the Community
data.description:
Golden State Dermatology Opens New Morgan Hill Clinic, Bringing Dedicated Board-Certified Dermatology Care to the Community

Golden State Dermatology Opens New Morgan Hill Clinic, Bringing Dedicated Board-Certified Dermatology Care to the Community

PR Newswire

MORGAN HILL, Calif., Oct. 16, 2026

The clinic opened October 15, 2026, with Frank Richard "Rick" Noodleman, MD, providing comprehensive medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology services.

MORGAN HILL, Calif., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Golden State Dermatology (GSD), a physician-led and physician-owned dermatology network growing across the Western and Central United States, is pleased to announce the opening of a new clinic in Morgan Hill, California. The clinic began seeing patients on October 15 at 17600 Monterey Road, Suite A.

The opening expands access to specialty healthcare in Morgan Hill, bringing comprehensive dermatology services closer to home. Led by experienced board-certified dermatologist Frank Richard "Rick" Noodleman, MD, the new clinic provides comprehensive medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology care. In addition to Dr. Noodleman, the clinic has an experienced esthetician providing professional skincare services tailored to each patient's individual needs and goals.

"I am very pleased to join Golden State Dermatology, an organization that shares my commitment to providing exceptional, patient-centered care," said Dr. Noodleman. "I already care for many patients from Morgan Hill and the surrounding communities, and I look forward to making high-quality medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology services more convenient and accessible for them while welcoming new patients."

A board-certified dermatologist who has been in practice since 1986, Dr. Noodleman offers a full range of services, including the diagnosis and treatment of medical skin conditions, skin cancer screenings, Mohs micrographic surgery and cosmetic dermatology. He also has extensive experience in dermatologic surgery and minimally invasive cosmetic procedures.

"Opening a clinic in Morgan Hill gives us the opportunity to address a meaningful need for dedicated dermatology services in the area," said Ed Becker, MD, founder of Golden State Dermatology. "Dr. Noodleman brings decades of experience, outstanding clinical training and a genuine commitment to his patients."

Appointments with Dr. Noodleman are now available. To learn more or schedule an appointment, visit www.goldenstatedermatology.com/morgan-hill.

About Golden State Dermatology

Golden State Dermatology is a physician-led and physician-owned dermatology network growing across the Western and Central United States. GSD was founded amid increasing consolidation in healthcare to preserve physician independence, support clinical excellence and ensure that patient care remains the highest priority.

Golden State Dermatology partners with leading dermatology practices and providers who share its commitment to personalized care and an outstanding patient experience. Its comprehensive services include medical dermatology, Mohs micrographic surgery, dermatopathology, cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery, vein treatments, and hair restoration.

To learn more about Golden State Dermatology or partnership opportunities, visit www.goldenstatedermatology.com/partnership-opportunities.

data.title: Nasdaq Posts Worst Weekly Drop in Months as Dow Edges to a Narrow Gain
data.description:
Nasdaq Posts Worst Weekly Drop in Months as Dow Edges to a Narrow Gain

Nasdaq Posts Worst Weekly Drop in Months as Dow Edges to a Narrow Gain

PR Newswire

VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 16, 2026

VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stock Preachers  News Commentary - Wall Street closed a volatile week split sharply down the middle. The Dow finished Friday at 52,134.63, down 0.08% on the day but still up 0.93% for the week, while the Nasdaq Composite tumbled 1.28% Friday and 3.64% for the week, its worst stretch in months. The S&P 500 fell 1.43% weekly and the Russell 2000 dropped 2.43%. The VIX climbed to 17.02 and the VXN jumped to 22.89, underscoring the growing divide between mega-cap tech weakness and broader market resilience. Active Companies from around the markets with current developments this week include: Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT), Beretta Holding S.A. (NYSE: RGR), Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC), CLPS Incorporation (Nasdaq: CLPS), and Orvana Minerals Corp. (TSX: ORV).

Friday's session showed the market's split personality in real time. The S&P 500 slid 0.58% to 7,699.50, pulling back from its week high of 7,821.67 and testing its 50-day EMA support near 7,681.97. The Nasdaq's 1.28% Friday drop capped a week that erased nearly 1,000 points, closing at 26,370.53 against a week high of 27,376.66, with RSI14 down to 40.4, signaling fading momentum.

Small caps lagged further, with the Russell 2000 down 1.03% Friday and 2.43% on the week, closing at 2,738.83 with an RSI14 of just 33.5, deep in weaker territory. The Dow bucked the trend, holding a 0.93% weekly gain and an 8.47% year-to-date advance, closing just under resistance at 52,281.19 and above its 50-day EMA support at 52,017.10.

Commodities sent mixed signals too. Gold slipped 0.10% for the week to $4,186.50 an ounce while silver fell 4.38% to $57.51. WTI crude jumped 4.17% weekly to $97.65 a barrel, up 70.06% year-to-date, while the 10-year Treasury yield eased 13 basis points to 5.11%, even as it ticked up 2 basis points on the day.

The full report breaks down the key support and resistance levels traders are watching next week along with sector-by-sector sentiment across the divided market.

CONTINUED... Read this and more news at: https://stockpreachers.com/articles/a-week-that-split-the-market-right-down-the-middle/

In other industry developments and happenings in the market this week include:

Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) Lockheed Martin delivered a C-130J-30 Super Hercules aircraft to the U.S. Navy at its Marietta, Georgia facility on Oct. 15, marking the start of its transformation into the E-130J Phoenix II, the Navy's next-generation TACAMO mission platform for airborne nuclear command and control.

The aircraft will next be transferred to Northrop Grumman, the mission systems integrator, to complete the conversion. "This delivery marks a historic milestone for the U.S. Navy, Lockheed Martin, and the nation's strategic communications network," said Trish Pagan, vice president of Lockheed Martin's Air Mobility & Maritime Missions.

The delivery revives the link between the TACAMO mission and the Hercules family, which previously flew the mission via the EC-130Q variant from 1963 until 1993.

Beretta Holding S.A. (NYSE: RGR) Beretta Holding announced preliminary results of its cash tender offer for shares of Sturm, Ruger & Company at $44.80 per share. The offer, which expired Oct. 15, sought up to 2,400,184 shares but drew 3,589,647 shares validly tendered, excluding 2,652,256 shares tendered by notice of guaranteed delivery.

Because the offer was oversubscribed, Beretta Holding estimates a preliminary proration factor of approximately 38.45%, subject to confirmation by the depositary following the guaranteed delivery period.

"This investment represents a significant milestone for Beretta Holding. It marks our first participation in a publicly listed company and opens a new chapter in our development as a long-term investor in the U.S. capital markets," said Pietro Gussalli Beretta, Chairman and CEO of Beretta Holding.

Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) Truist Financial Corporation reported its third quarter 2026 results, with details available through its earnings release, investor presentation and Quarterly Performance Summary posted to the company's investor relations website.

The company hosted a live earnings call at 8 a.m. ET the same day, with a replay made available on its website for 30 days.

Truist describes itself as a top-10 commercial bank with total assets of $554 billion as of Sept. 30, 2026, offering consumer and small business banking, commercial and corporate banking, investment banking, wealth management, payments and specialized lending.

CLPS Incorporation (Nasdaq: CLPS) CLPS Incorporation reported full fiscal year 2026 revenue growth of 4.7% year-over-year to $172.2 million, and second-half revenue growth of 6.6% to $87.1 million, despite revenue pressure from the downsizing of a key client's China Solution Centers.

Revenue from customized IT solution services surged 113.9% year-over-year to $5.9 million for the full year, while revenue generated outside mainland China rose 47.5% to $62.7 million, with Hong Kong SAR up 61.0% to $23.2 million and Japan up 122.7% to $4.5 million.

"Fiscal 2026 was a pivotal year of structural transition and resilience for CLPS," said Raymond Lin, Chief Executive Officer of CLPS. "Since becoming a publicly traded company in 2018, we have expanded our topline from $48.9 million to $172.2 million, delivering a robust 17.0% compound annual growth rate over the past eight years."

Orvana Minerals Corp. (TSX: ORV) Orvana Minerals Corp. reported fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 production results, with consolidated FY2026 production of 45,160 gold equivalent ounces, comprised of 39,282 gold ounces, 3.1 million pounds of copper and 112,499 silver ounces.

Orovalle produced 37,775 ounces of gold and 2.9 million pounds of copper in FY2026, exceeding gold production guidance of 34,000 to 37,000 ounces and landing within copper guidance of 2,700 to 3,000 thousand pounds. EMIPA produced its first dore and copper cathodes from the expanded Don Mario Plant during the quarter but came in below the company's FY2026 guidance, which was withdrawn on September 17, 2026.

"Looking ahead to FY2027, our focus remains on sustaining disciplined production performance and operational efficiency while managing inflationary cost pressures arising from broader global conditions and continued workforce challenges."

data.title: Welcome to the 'AI burnout trade' - as investors grow tired of debating tech's promises
data.description:
By Hannah Pedone

AI is likely to pay off eventually, but investors are getting sick of all the hand-wringing over near-term returns, analysts say

AI stocks have come under pressure as investors lose patience with endless valuation debates

As a major chip index heads for its eighth straight session of declines, it's becoming harder to distinguish investor concern from sheer fatigue.

Nicholas Colas, co-founder of DataTrek Research, called the current market action evidence of an "AI burnout trade." In other words, investors are getting sick of projecting payoffs from investments in technology with uncertain, far-off returns - and they're also tired of debating what that means in the here and now.

"Should an investor in the S&P 500 care about the next 36 months or the next decade? We all know the answer is the latter, but fretting over the former can be (or, frankly, is) exhausting," Colas wrote.

Investors are also finding it challenging to "cut through the noise surrounding artificial intelligence - from the grand promises of transformative growth and the massive costs of data-center build-outs, to concerns about AI displacing jobs and the steady stream of new chip or model announcements that arrive almost daily," said Luke Rahbari, the co-portfolio manager of the Rational Equity Armor Fund.

He agreed that "many have grown weary of trying to look years ahead at the ultimate payoff."

For the last several years, the market has rewarded companies when they announce a new, larger model, a larger data center, or a bigger AI-infrastructure commitment. But that's changing as investors are demanding clearer proof that capital spending can translate into sustainable revenue growth, StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee told MarketWatch.

Lately, there has been consternation around reports of financial metrics from leading private AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic. The market can show "little mercy when expectations and reported figures diverge, and AI-related stocks quickly began to show cracks," Lee added.

Peter Berezin, the chief economist at BCA Research, told MarketWatch that there's also concern that spending on AI tokens - the units of data that AI models process, and that providers bill for - is slowing. That could pose challenges for AI companies. According to his estimates, AI companies will need $10 trillion in annual sales to generate a "decent rate of return" on their spending on AI data centers.

See also: The murky AI milestone that has some of the industry's leading voices increasingly on edge

The PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX is down for the eighth day in a row and trading at its lowest level in a month. Shares of CoreWeave (CRWV), which has become the poster child for AI borrowing needs, are down to their lowest point since July.

Investors are growing tired of "financing AI on faith," Lee said.

CoreWeave, which rents out Nvidia's (NVDA) graphics processing units and supplies AI labs like OpenAI, became another "flashpoint" this week, he said. Shares of CrowdStrike have lost nearly 25% this week and are tracking toward their steepest weekly decline in about 11 months. The swift move downward demonstrates how quickly investors can punish companies when questions arise around their capacity to finance infrastructure with the expectation that returns will emerge years later, he explained.

DataTrek's Colas noted various other issues spooking investors, such as the idea that the average person probably isn't paying to use AI and that many Americans have "at best, mixed feelings" about the encroachment of technology on everyday life.

"The old dictum that 'markets hate uncertainty' is forever true, and there is more than enough uncertainty around AI for many bucketloads of investor discontent," Colas wrote. That said, "in our view this does not make for a particularly satisfying equity market bear case," as AI will deliver a payoff over a longer time horizon, he said.

-Hannah Pedone

What is the Gildan Activewear securities fraud lawsuit about?

The lawsuit alleges that Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL) engaged in securities fraud during the Class Period by allegedly maintaining inadequate internal controls and allegedly employing channel stuffing to artificially inflate the appearance of revenue growth. Specifically, the complaint alleges that Gildan's organic growth had in fact been negative for years, even as reported revenues appeared to grow, and that the company allegedly created a product overhang of approximately $500 million through persistent and increasing channel stuffing practices. As a result, the lawsuit alleges that Defendants' public statements concerning Gildan's business, operations, and prospects were materially false and misleading and/or lacked a reasonable basis throughout the Class Period. These allegations were brought to light following the publication of a short-seller research report on June 16, 2026.

A lead plaintiff is a court-appointed representative who acts on behalf of the entire class of similarly situated investors in directing the litigation, including selecting and overseeing lead counsel. Importantly, investors need not seek or serve as lead plaintiff to participate in or share in any recovery that may result from this lawsuit.
